That would mean the model encodes m2-weighted physical force even though next-step prediction does not require it. If accel_step also loses its margin (< 0.1), the wider mass range broke the probe rather than separating the targets, and the result is inconclusive.
expected_if_true: In both seeds at the final checkpoint: the accel_step margin is >= 0.1 at some layer, accel_step R2 exceeds force R2 by >= 0.1, and the force margin is below the accel_step margin. It should also be smaller than the force margin in the matched default-mass-range run (E5 proposal, same architecture and training) by >= 0.05.
